REVIEW-E graphite half (068, 070, 071): PASS. No demonstrated mismatch, zero fixes demanded; 5 NFI rows landed in the card. 28 load-bearing numbers re-derived with own arithmetic; owner code never read or run.

068: film improvement 1.529 vs mine 1.5286 (-0.03%); all six comparison improvements, multipliers 1.219/1.056, constant-E densities 1846/2130, line densities and areas reproduce.

070: Vc law reproduces exactly (0.0 rel diff) on all 56 rows; crimping+scarf co-bind at 1.0+/-1e-6 on every gamma1 row against a solved constant applied stress 303.7436 MPa = strength/face_compression on every row; mass bills to machine epsilon; closure exact (closed payload <=2.8e-5 lift, rho=2250/factor); no case floats; density factors gamma1 1.067-1.248, gamma0.20 worst 1.693/1.478 match.

071: thermal 0.535943 exact; release identity delta-alpha 24.6e-6*0.536 = core_release+1.0e-6 exact; bond 1.866, screen 0.322 MPa; 3.467/3.137 -> 649/717 kg/m3; scarf case 2.89, payload -87877 = released row. Nuance: R30 releases at 15.9 mm core (physics); R20 sits on the admitted 2.4 mm floor.

CR-1457 2.3/6.2: Kc branches verbatim, unity knockdown at Vc>=2 admissible; global buckling within 0.4% (their side higher, non-binding). Join: graphite needs 1329-2109 kg/m3 vs 069's 1013.8 @290 GPa float, thermal 0.536 - 069's point stands as the only modeled float.

NFI: sigma_appl level; Kc blend; growth+joining decomposition; gamma_d figure; wrinkling level/scarf screen. Artifacts pinned.
